macros.name: regbits
macros.doc: The \regbits macro typesets a register field without showing bit positions.

macros.name: regBitSize
macros.doc: The \regBitSize command controls the font size used for bit values, \regResetSize controls the font size used for reset values, and \regBitFamily controls which font family is used to denote bit positions.

macros.name: regBitWidth
macros.doc: The macro \regBitWidth specifies the maximum number of bits to be typeset on a single line.

macros.name: regDescFamily
macros.doc: \regDescFamily controls the appearance of field names within register descriptions.

macros.name: regFloatName
macros.doc: The \regFloatName provides the default string used to label each register diagram.

macros.name: regLabelSize
macros.doc: The font size for field names and for the \regResetName is controlled by \regLabelSize, defined further below.

macros.name: regnewline
macros.doc: Once a line has been completed, a new line can be inserted via \regnewline.

macros.name: regResetName
macros.doc: The string with which to label reset values is \regResetName.

macros.name: regResetSize
macros.doc: The \regBitSize command controls the font size used for bit values, \regResetSize controls the font size used for reset values, and \regBitFamily controls which font family is used to denote bit positions.

macros.name: regspace
macros.doc: An invisible box with the same width as a specified number of bits is typeset by \regspace.

macros.name: TRfamily
macros.doc: The font family used for the TR flags can be controlled via \TRfamily.

macros.name: TRwidth
macros.doc: The width available for TR flags is controlled by \TRwidth, which by default is set to \marginparwidth.

envs.name: regdesc
envs.doc: The purpose of regdesc is really just to turn on centering and, when the LyX package option is specified, redefine the lyxlist environment.
